verdict.rationale: HubSpot has a documented MCP server granting read/write access to CRM data (contacts, deals, engagements) and a full REST API for creating/updating contacts and custom objects, plus automatic deduplication and owner/property assignment via API/workflows, which together support agent-driven lead enrichment. However, no evidence explicitly confirms an end-to-end single-call workflow for company enrichment plus owner assignment via MCP, so this remains a plausible but unverified composite capability.
